title: Prevent snapshot path-resolution stalls
summary: Prevents dashboard snapshots from resolving stale destination shares and fixes Local API lifecycle recovery startup so the listener stays running after bootstrap.
reason: Live stack evidence showed snapshot-to-DTO construction blocked in rerun destination summary path resolution, while the fresh backend then exited with a NameError before the shell could use it.
behavior_before: The Home snapshot's display-only CSV-rerun destination summary resolved filesystem paths, which can block on an unavailable UNC path. Fresh Local API startup then referenced an out-of-scope resolved_state variable and crashed after printing its bootstrap line.
behavior_after: Destination summaries compare text-only Windows paths without filesystem access, and lifecycle recovery reads the server-owned resolved-path provider so the local API remains available after startup.
manual_validation: GREEN: 25 targeted Python tests passed, including rerun results, status snapshots, Local API snapshot recovery, and backend startup recovery.
Live proof: a fresh token-protected backend served five consecutive /api/snapshot requests with HTTP 200 in 622-2838 ms and no error code or warnings.
Local API lifecycle contract smoke passed.
RED: destination summary test failed when path resolution was called; Local API main startup test failed with NameError: resolved_state is not defined.
rollback_plan: Revert the two production files and their regression tests. This update changes read-only snapshot and lifecycle startup behavior only; it does not alter source media, FFmpeg policy, publishing, settings, queue data, or manifests.
notes:
The display-only path key deliberately avoids Path.resolve() because Windows can contact a stale/offline share during resolution.
The attempted Tauri dev smoke did not complete because the tool host lost stdout; temporary proof and smoke processes were stopped.
No media was processed.
